exposure: exclusive use of intragestational sac potassium chloride (KCl) and methotrexate (MTX)
outcome: Effectiveness of intragestational sac KCl and MTX in managing viable cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: 9 patients with CSP (6 with viable CSP requiring intervention)
finding: Intragestational sac KCl plus MTX was effective in managing viable CSP and may be a first-line minimally invasive treatment option in patients desiring future fertility.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at treatment among patients in Group II was 54.33 ± 7.51 days (range 46-65)
